title: Find four missing tins
issue: The stock ledger and the physical count disagree for SKU TIN-24.
goal: Check the closing-stock calculation before reporting a discrepancy.
sourceText: SKU TIN-24. Opening: 120. Received: 30. Sold: 18. Counted: 128.

spans.seen: The row for TIN-24 shows opening 120, received 30 and sold 18.
spans.speech: This is TIN twenty-four. Check the SKU before checking its totals.

spans.seen: The formula is =B4+C5-D4. It returns 114. The C5 reference points to the next row, which has 12 received.
spans.speech: The old formula pulls receipts from the next row. That twelve belongs to another item.

spans.action: Use receipts from the same row
spans.seen: The formula changes to =B4+C4-D4. Expected closing stock becomes 132.
spans.speech: Use C4 for this SKU. Start with one hundred twenty, add thirty received, then subtract eighteen sold.

spans.seen: Counted stock is 128 and expected stock is 132. The signed difference is minus 4.
spans.speech: The count is one hundred twenty-eight. Subtract expected stock from counted stock. Four tins are missing.

spans.action: Record the shortage and verify source records
spans.seen: The worksheet shows SHORT 4 with a note to check receipts and recount.
spans.speech: Record the shortage. Keep the count and formula visible. Recount and check the receipt before adjusting the ledger.

followup.question: Why did the contributor keep the count and formula visible?
followup.answer: Keeping both values lets a second person repeat the calculation, check the receipt and recount before changing the stock record.
followup.provenance: Scripted contributor answer for the synthetic demonstration

en: Read opening stock, receipts and sales from the same item row.
Compute expected stock as opening plus received minus sold.
Subtract expected from counted stock. A negative result is a shortage.
kn: ಒಂದೇ ಸಾಲಿನ ಆರಂಭಿಕ ದಾಸ್ತಾನು, ಸ್ವೀಕರಿಸಿದ ಸರಕು ಮತ್ತು ಮಾರಾಟದ ಸಂಖ್ಯೆಯನ್ನು ಓದಿ.
ನಿರೀಕ್ಷಿತ ದಾಸ್ತಾನು = ಆರಂಭಿಕ ದಾಸ್ತಾನು + ಸ್ವೀಕರಿಸಿದ ಸರಕು − ಮಾರಾಟ.
ಎಣಿಸಿದ ದಾಸ್ತಾನಿನಿಂದ ನಿರೀಕ್ಷಿತ ದಾಸ್ತಾನು ಕಳೆಯಿರಿ. ಋಣಾತ್ಮಕ ಫಲಿತಾಂಶವು ಕೊರತೆಯನ್ನು ಸೂಚಿಸುತ್ತದೆ.
learning.mixed: SKU TIN-24 row ನೋಡಿ. Opening 120, received 30, sold 18. =B4+C4-D4 ಹಾಕಿ. Expected 132, counted 128, difference −4.
